owner.O1.subject: DebateAI tax summary for {quarter}
owner.O1.intro: Here is the tax summary for {quarter}, built from our own charge records. Each line shows the country or state, net sales, tax collected, whether we are registered there, and where and by when to pay.
owner.O2.subject: A refund could not be completed and needs your attention
owner.O2.intro: A refund we asked for could not be completed: NETOPIA refused it, or its outcome stayed unknown after every retry. No more tries are made by themselves.
owner.O2.next: Check this payment in NETOPIA's admin and settle the refund by hand there. The owner summary lists it until then.
owner.O2.notRequestedIntro: A refund job was stopped before anything was sent to NETOPIA: it does not match any refund request our records hold for this payment. No money moved, and no more tries are made.
owner.O2.notRequestedAmount: Amount the job named: {refundAmount}. This is only the job's own figure, not a refund to make.
owner.O2.notRequestedNext: Do not refund anything for this job. Something able to write to the billing database queued it, so tell whoever runs the server. They check this charge's own refund requests: a request that was never refunded is still owed.
owner.O2.otherSystemIntro: A refund job was stopped before anything was sent: the payment it names was taken in another payment system than the one this server uses (the previous card processor, or NETOPIA's sandbox or live). No money moved.
owner.O2.otherSystemNext: Nothing is owed on this server. If it was a real customer's payment in the other system, refund it in that system's admin; a sandbox test payment needs nothing. The owner summary lists it as REFUND_OTHER_SYSTEM.
owner.O2.withdrawalDeadline: This is a withdrawal refund: the law requires it to be made by {refundDeadline} at the latest (14 days after the withdrawal). First look at this payment in NETOPIA's admin. If it already shows a refund of {refundAmount}, an earlier attempt went through: do not refund again. If it shows none, refund exactly {refundAmount} on this payment, in one refund. A refund of the whole payment is recorded by the site itself; for part of a payment, record it once it is made with the refund-done command, run as root on the server as the runbook shows. The customer's refund email (M8) then follows by itself.
owner.O2_WITHDRAWAL.subject: A withdrawal needs you to settle its refund by hand
owner.O2_WITHDRAWAL.intro: A customer withdrew from their plan, and the plan has ended. A refund made in NETOPIA's admin, or an earlier refund request, already touched one of their payments, so the site could not work out what is still due. Nothing has been refunded for this withdrawal yet.
owner.O2_WITHDRAWAL.deadline: Withdrawn on {withdrawalDate}. The law requires the refund to be made by {refundDeadline} at the latest (14 days after the withdrawal).
owner.O2_WITHDRAWAL.next: Work out what is still due as the runbook describes ("A withdrawal sent by email or on the model form"), refund in NETOPIA's admin what the site cannot, then record the settlement with the command below, run as root on the server. The customer's refund email (M8) follows. The owner summary lists it as WITHDRAWAL_BY_OWNER until then.
owner.O2_WITHDRAWAL.command: systemd-run --pipe --wait --collect --uid=debateai-api --gid=debateai-api --property=EnvironmentFile=/etc/debateai/api.env --working-directory=/opt/debateai/dialectical-engine /usr/bin/pnpm billing:withdraw --owner {ownerRef} --refund <amount through this command> --dashboard <amount refunded in NETOPIA's admin>
owner.O2_REFUND_DUE.subject: A refund to make in NETOPIA's admin
owner.O2_REFUND_DUE.intro: A refund is owed. NETOPIA's refund call is not in use yet, so please make this refund yourself in NETOPIA's admin.
owner.O2_REFUND_DUE.part: This is part of the payment, not all of it.
owner.O2_REFUND_DUE.deadline: This is a withdrawal refund: the law requires it by {refundDeadline} at the latest (14 days after the withdrawal).
owner.O2_REFUND_DUE.next: First look at the payment in NETOPIA's admin. If it already shows a refund of this amount, do not refund it again: only run the command below. If it shows none, refund exactly this amount on this payment in NETOPIA's admin, in one refund.
owner.O2_REFUND_DUE.recordedBySite: Once NETOPIA reports the refund, the site records it by itself, and the customer's email and the credit note follow. If it is still open in the site's next reminder, record it yourself with the command below, run as root on the server: run it once to see what it records, then again with --confirm added at the end to record it.
owner.O2_REFUND_DUE.command: Once it is done, record it with the command below, run as root on the server (the site cannot tell a partial refund from a whole one): run it once to see what it records, then again with --confirm added at the end to record it.
owner.O2_REFUND_DUE.reminded: The site reminds you every third day while this refund is open, and every day from three days before a withdrawal's deadline.
owner.O2_REFUND_REMINDER.subject: Refunds still open in NETOPIA's admin: {refundCount}
owner.O2_REFUND_REMINDER.intro: First look at the payment in NETOPIA's admin. If it already shows a refund of this amount, do not refund it again: only run the command below. Do this for each refund listed here: each is owed, and not yet recorded on the site. If its payment shows no such refund, make it in NETOPIA's admin exactly as listed, in one refund. Then run the command under it as root on the server: once to see what it records, then again with --confirm added at the end to record it.
owner.O2_REFUND_REMINDER.seen: A line marked "NETOPIA shows a refund" was seen refunded at NETOPIA; only its command is missing.
owner.O3.subject: Billing needs your attention ({reasonCode})
owner.O3.intro: A job that issues an invoice or a credit note, or that sends an email, stopped after its last try. That job is not tried again by itself; only the notice of a changed renewal amount (M3) is sent again, by the renewal.
owner.O3.listed: The owner summary (the quarterly email, or the tax summary command run as root on the server as the runbook shows) lists it until it is settled.
owner.O3.paymentIntro: A payment needs your attention. Nothing more was charged. The steps below say what the customer was told, if anything.
owner.O3.paymentListed: This email is sent once for this reference and reason within the hour.
owner.O4.subject: A NETOPIA payment message could not be verified ({reasonCode})
owner.O4.intro: NETOPIA sent a message about one of our open payments, and the site could not verify it with the trusted NETOPIA key. It was answered "try again", so NETOPIA keeps sending it, and a sealed copy is kept for 14 days.
owner.O4.next: Check the NETOPIA key with the check command, run as root on the server as the runbook shows. If the key is wrong or out of date, put the right one in place with deploy/vps/billing-setup.sh --replace netopia and restart the API: every kept message is checked again at the start, saved cards included.
owner.O4.listed: At most one such email is sent an hour; the owner summary (the quarterly email, or the tax summary command) counts every kept message by day.
